title: Agent Hooks — reserved host_warning:* reasons
description: Host-synthesized warning reasons (AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §11.1), placed on the allow a host substitutes under on_error: continue (§6.3.1). Interceptors MUST NOT emit warning reasons with the host_warning: prefix; a host treats such a verdict as host_error:verdict_invalid (§5).

warnings.cause: A registration whose on_error is continue failed (raised, timed out or returned an invalid verdict); the host substituted an allow in its slot and continued (§6.3.1). The message names the binding and the host_error:* reason.
